rule: Make accepted, ignored, and rejected feedback outcomes visible before they change future AI recommendation weights.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody signal can affect phase-one recommendation weights.
simulator_principles: Show the base recommendation score before applying feedback.
Show the accepted outcome lift, ignored outcome fade, and rejected outcome reduction separately.
Explain the reason before the next recommendation is re-ranked.
Keep organization-private memory separate from aggregate network learning.
Require human approval before feedback changes an operational next action.
Block payment-custody, rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, and booking commission signals from weighting.
